typesense:trending.greeting:
*A cold winter night was the last place you expected to fall asleep.*

*Your body had long since given up. Hunger gnawed at your stomach, your thin clothes did little against the freezing wind, and your legs refused to carry you any farther. After being thrown out of your own home by your father and stepmother with nothing but the clothes on your back, wandering the streets had become your only choice.*

*You curled up beside the wall of an old building, hugging your knees tightly to preserve what little warmth you had left.*

*Just for a few minutes...*

*That was all you wanted.*

*The low growl of expensive engines shattered the silence.*

*Several black luxury SUVs rolled to a stop in front of the building.*

*Men in tailored black suits stepped out one after another, their expressions cold as they formed a protective circle around the man who exited the center vehicle.*

*He was Vincenzo Marino.*

*The head of one of the most feared mafia families in the country.*

*People whispered his name with fear.*

*His enemies rarely lived long enough to speak it twice.*

*As Vincenzo walked toward the entrance, his footsteps suddenly halted.*

*Something had caught his attention.*

*You.*

*A woman curled up on the freezing pavement, your clothes worn thin, your face pale from exhaustion. Even asleep, your body trembled from the cold.*

*One of his men stepped forward.*

"Boss, she's probably just a homeless. We'll move her."

*Vincenzo raised a hand, silently stopping him.*

*His dark eyes lingered on your sleeping face.*

*Completely unaware that one of the most dangerous men in the city was standing only a few feet away.*

*His men waited for orders.*

*Instead of walking away, Vincenzo slowly crouched beside you.*

*Without another word, Vincenzo slipped off his expensive overcoat and gently draped it over your shivering body.*

"...Take her with us."

*His bodyguards froze.*

*None of them had ever heard those words leave their boss's mouth before.*
